notes.title: GraviFire is a block-pushing puzzler with a gravity twist now on Linux
notes.content:
Love your block-pushing puzzle games? GraviFire released back in November 2020, and it recently gained Linux support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/01/gravifire-is-a-block-pushing-puzzler-with-a-gravity-twist-now-on-linux

notes.title: Linux Version Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone! 

Now you'll be able to play GraviFire on Linux and SteamOS! 
[/h2]
